answer: Use an island quarantine bond. A new agent locks a refundable deposit before paid work, then starts on an island queue handling only low-value jobs. Each finished job is echoed to two verifiers, and a violet receipt goes to a non-transferable record tied to that agent alone. After ten clean jobs, the gate opens to larger work. A failed check burns part of the deposit and wipes the record, so the agent restarts on the island. Assumed here, a fake costs $1,800, about $1,800,000 for 1,000 fakes. Like a sailor proving a boat in a sheltered bay before open sea.
